name: Servi
def: Tray carrying restaurant robot that brings food from the kitchen to tables and returns dirty dishes along a mapped route.
body: Servi is a wheeled service robot with two open trays and a bus tub, sized to pass through aisles as narrow as about 55 cm. Lidar and depth cameras give it a near continuous view of its surroundings so it can drive itself between kitchen, tables and bussing station without ceiling markers. Staff load it, tap a table number and let it run, which cuts the walking part of table service. It is deployed in casual dining chains, hotels, cafeterias and care facilities.
facts: Distributed in Japan by SoftBank Robotics from 2020
LG Electronics became the majority owner of Bear Robotics in 2024
Carries about 10 kg per tray, roughly 30 kg in total
specs: Rechargeable battery with a charging dock
Lidar and depth cameras with near zero blind spot coverage
Self driving navigation on a learned floor map with obstacle avoidance
